one_line_thesis: Debt-free East Tennessee land company (73,000+ acres) operating Windrock Park OHV recreation plus timber/royalty income; watch at ~$520 with 5.91% base annual return on ~$38/sh normalized owner cash.

deep_dive.executive_summary: Windrock Land Company is a 153-year-old East Tennessee landowner operating America's largest private OHV park plus timber, royalty, and tower-income streams on 73,000+ acres. FY2025 audited financials show ~$12.9 million revenue, ~$4.0 million segment operating income, zero debt at year-end, ~$2.4 million cash, and ~$6.0 million of mark-to-market securities. We normalize starting owner cash to ~$38 per share (cash from operations minus maintenance capital spending, excluding net securities trading gains). At ~$520 per share, base case annual return is 5.91% per year. Dhando is partial: debt...
